<!--This page is generated from [`data/publications.csv`](data/publications.csv).
To add, edit, or remove a paper, just edit that CSV file and re-render the
site — no HTML or Markdown editing required. Columns: `type` (one of
`Working Paper`, `Work in Progress`, `Publication`), `title`, `authors`,
`venue`, `year`, `link`, `abstract`.-->

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

invisible(try(Sys.setlocale("LC_CTYPE", "en_US.UTF-8"), silent = TRUE))

esc <- function(x) {
  x <- ifelse(is.na(x), "", x)
  x <- gsub("&", "&amp;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("<", "&lt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub(">", "&gt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x
}

has_val <- function(x) !is.na(x) && nzchar(trimws(x))

pubs <- read.csv("data/publications.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, colClasses = "character")

section_order <- c(
  "Working Paper"    = "Working Papers",
  "Publication"       = "Publications",
  "Work in Progress"  = "Work in Progress"
)

for (type_key in names(section_order)) {
  rows <- pubs[pubs$type == type_key, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(rows) == 0) next

  cat("## ", section_order[[type_key]], "\n\n", sep = "")

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(rows))) {
    r <- rows[i, ]
    cat("::: pub-entry\n")
    cat("<span class='pub-title'>", esc(r$title), "</span><br>\n", sep = "")
    meta <- esc(r$authors)
    if (has_val(r$venue)) meta <- paste0(meta, ". ", esc(r$venue))
    if (has_val(r$year)) meta <- paste0(meta, ". ", r$year)
    cat("<span class='pub-meta'>", meta, ".</span>", sep = "")
    if (has_val(r$link)) {
      cat(" [\\[Link\\]](", r$link, ")", sep = "")
    }
    cat("\n\n")
    if (has_val(r$abstract)) {
      cat("<details><summary>Abstract</summary>\n\n", esc(r$abstract), "\n\n</details>\n", sep = "")
    }
    cat(":::\n\n")
  }
}
```
